secrets.name: The Snow Cave
secrets.text: Inside the drift it is blue and quiet and nearly warm. Someone dug this out with their hands, lined it with books, and left a candle burning.

meta.label: The Snow Stacks
meta.blurb: Snow is falling between the stacks. It drifts against the shelves and does not melt, and at the end of the long aisle a fire is burning for nobody.
